title: Try to use Delta Lake in AWS Glue with saveAsTable
question:
I am trying to have an experience with Delta data in AWS Glue. I am creating an AWS Glue job using Glue 4.0 version.

In Job details I added two job parameters:

  • --conf Value:spark.sql.extensions=io.delta.sql.DeltaSparkSessionExtension --conf spark.sql.catalog.spark_catalog=org.apache.spark.sql.delta.catalog.DeltaCatalog
  • --datalake-formats Value:delta

The code:

job = Job(glueContext)

#DUMMY DATA THAT WILL BE REPLACED FOR A DYNAMIC SOURCE

I followed the AWS page -> https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-format-delta-lake.html

The error is always the same

I already tried to create the table manually before execute the AWS Glue job but the errors keeps the same.

Anyone had the same issue?

Thanks
answer:
Your database probably doesn't have a location set in the Glue catalog. Try creating a database with a specified location.:

CREATE DATABASE mydatabase
LOCATION 's3://mybucket/mydatabase/';
